course_details: This course is tailored for IT and computing graduates and related disciplines eager to specialise in AI, addressing the skills gap in industries like finance, healthcare, and agriculture. Choose this course to stay ahead in the AI revolution, gaining both foundational and advanced insights into data analytics, machine learning, and AI applications.Distinctively, the program offers specialisation in high-demand fields such as Computer Vision and Natural Language Processing to solve real-world problems. You'll acquire the ability to design, implement, and manage AI systems responsibly and effectively.You will learn through hands-on projects, collaborating with peers and experts to apply AI technologies in real-world scenarios. This approach ensures you develop both the technical proficiency and the practical experience necessary for a successful career in AI.

items.name: Business Intelligence for Decision Support
items.description: This subject delves into business intelligence (BI), a comprehensive term encompassing architectures, tools, databases, analytics, applications, and methodologies aimed at facilitating interactive data access and empowering managers to make informed decisions. It introduces decision support systems (DSS), which are computer-based systems combining models, methods, and data to tackle semi-structured or unstructured decisions, demanding user involvement and a user-friendly interface. As high-level business decisions often fall into these categories and are data-intensive, DSS are increasingly integrated with BI techniques for enhanced problem-solving. You'll learn about various aspects of BI and DSS, including group and intelligent support systems, web-based systems, decision optimisation, and personalised recommender systems. Additionally, the subject teaches the design, implementation, and integration of BI techniques to bolster business decision-making processes.

items.description:
This subject introduces quantum computation, a model of computation based on the physical laws of quantum mechanics. Quantum computers outperform traditional computers for a range of practical problems, and in many cases offer drastic advantages.
In this subject, you will learn about the basic tools for understanding quantum information processing. You will apply this knowledge to study the key quantum protocols: teleportation, superdense coding, and simple quantum algorithms.The subject covers key features of quantum theory which differentiate it from classical theory, including quantum entanglement and coherence.

Complete all of the following subjects:

items.name: Reinforcement Learning
items.description: This subject introduces you to reinforcement learning, the study of how machines learn from interactions with their environment. A subset of machine learning, it's essential for automated decision-making and AI, teaching programs to predict and act optimally through experience. You'll explore its applications in control systems, gaming, and inventory management. The subject covers both theory and practice, including Markov Decision Processes, classic and modern algorithms, and hands-on agent training using cutting-edge software tools. By the end, you'll understand value functions, explore exploration versus exploitation, and be able to deploy an AI system to solve real-world problems in your final project.
